name: Octree Leaf Construction with QEF Surface Fitting
definition: Construction of an octree leaf node representing a voxel containing a surface, using a Quadratic Error Function (QEF) solver to determine the precise surface position and normal from edge intersections.
summary: Octree Leaf Construction with QEF Surface Fitting determines precise surface position and normal by solving a Quadratic Error Function over all edge crossings, differing from local marching cubes-style triangulation.
